SYNTHESIZED — no real Antigravity transcript was available on this machine.

This fixture mimics the Antigravity agent store as defined by the adapter
(see `src/agents/gemini.rs`): `<data_dir>/antigravity/<version>/sessions/`
holding per-session chat JSON documents with the same `messages`-array
shape as Gemini CLI chats. The store is keyed by version directory because
Antigravity ships its own forked layout that drifts per release; the
adapter reports the version as `antigravity-<version>` from the directory
name and ALWAYS ships `adapter_version_verified == false` (binding user
decision, like omp). Records parse with the same mapper as Gemini CLI;
the `agent_state` record is an Antigravity-only shape with no Gemini
mapping, so it falls back to `system { text: <raw JSON> }` — never
dropped, never an error — and the golden test asserts its kinds and
payload. Session id, version, model name, token counts, and prose are
invented.
